svg.title: The jPipe assemble operator, shown abstractly
svg.desc: On the left, two independent justifications stacked vertically, each with its own author figure. Justification A is gold, justification B is maroon; each has an evidence node supporting a strategy supporting a conclusion, with arrows pointing upward. Both feed into a chip labelled assemble. On the right, the assembled justification keeps both coloured subtrees intact as sub-conclusions, with a new grey strategy and a new grey conclusion added on top, all arrows still pointing upward.
